scene.name: Sanctum of the Crown
scene.dm_notes: Prepared from supplied image(2).png. Scale: 5 feet per printed square; 33.75 source pixels per square, 32 × 46 board. Original art is embedded unchanged. Editable walls trace the usable floor boundary. The paired south gate opens/closes both leaves; open cells are traversable. Entry spawn is in the southern vestibule. Upper nave rises in 1-foot tiers to 4 feet, with a 5-foot throne dais. Window/column footprints obstruct movement; medallions remain walkable. No enemies or automatic battle boundaries are assumed. New procedural assets are installed from this package into Imported · Crown hall.
